# Tuteliq Roblox SDK

> AI-powered child safety moderation for Roblox — detects grooming, bullying, and unsafe content in real-time chat.

## What is this?
A Roblox Luau module for the Tuteliq child safety API. Moderate in-game chat in real-time, detecting bullying, grooming, self-harm, and other harmful content targeting young players.

## Install
Add the TuteliqSDK module to your Roblox game via the Roblox Creator Store or copy the module into ServerScriptService.

## Quick Start
local Tuteliq = require(game.ServerScriptService.TuteliqSDK)
local client = Tuteliq.new({ apiKey = "tq_your_key" })
local result = client:detectUnsafe({ text = "message to check", ageGroup = "10-12" })

## Key Features
- Real-time chat moderation
- Roblox-native Luau module
- Age-appropriate calibration for young players
- Bullying, grooming, and unsafe content detection
- Low-latency for in-game use
